title: Osservazioni: past simple, past continuous e while

sentences.it: Ieri sera ho guardato un film con mia sorella.
sentences.en: Last night I watched a film with my sister.
alternatives: I watched a film with my sister last night.
Last night I watched a movie with my sister.
I watched a movie with my sister last night.
sentences.hint: past simple — last night, watch, film, sister

sentences.en: Yesterday I went to the supermarket.
alternatives: I went to the supermarket yesterday.

sentences.it: Stavo leggendo il giornale quando è squillato il telefono.
sentences.en: I was reading the newspaper when the phone rang.
alternatives: I was reading the paper when the phone rang.
sentences.hint: past continuous + when + past simple — read, newspaper, phone, ring

sentences.it: Mentre facevo la doccia, è andata via l'acqua.
sentences.en: While I was taking a shower, the water turned off.
alternatives: While I was having a shower, the water turned off.
The water turned off while I was taking a shower.
The water turned off while I was having a shower.
sentences.hint: while + past continuous, poi past simple — take a shower, water, turn off

sentences.it: Mentre tornavo a casa a piedi, ho visto un arcobaleno.
sentences.en: While I was walking home, I saw a rainbow.
alternatives: I saw a rainbow while I was walking home.
sentences.hint: while + past continuous, poi past simple — walk home, see, rainbow

sentences.it: Ha cominciato a piovere mentre il presidente stava parlando.
sentences.en: It started to rain while the president was speaking.
alternatives: It started raining while the president was speaking.
It began to rain while the president was speaking.
It started to rain while the president was talking.
It started raining while the president was talking.
sentences.hint: past simple + while + past continuous — start, rain, president, speak

sentences.en: What did you see while you were walking?
sentences.hint: domanda al past simple + while + past continuous — see, walk

sentences.it: Mentre guidavamo abbiamo bucato una gomma.
sentences.en: While we were driving we got a flat tire.
alternatives: While we were driving we got a flat tyre.
We got a flat tire while we were driving.
We got a flat tyre while we were driving.
sentences.hint: while + past continuous, poi past simple — drive, get, flat tire

sentences.it: Mentre io cucinavo, mio marito apparecchiava la tavola.
sentences.en: While I was cooking, my husband was setting the table.
alternatives: My husband was setting the table while I was cooking.
While I was cooking, my husband was laying the table.
My husband was laying the table while I was cooking.
sentences.hint: while + due azioni al past continuous — cook, husband, set the table

sentences.it: Mentre dormivamo, qualcuno ha bussato alla porta.
sentences.en: While we were sleeping, someone knocked on the door.
alternatives: While we were sleeping, somebody knocked on the door.
Someone knocked on the door while we were sleeping.
Somebody knocked on the door while we were sleeping.
sentences.hint: while + past continuous, poi past simple — sleep, someone, knock on the door

sentences.it: Quando ero bambina amavo la pioggia.
sentences.en: When I was a child I loved the rain.
alternatives: When I was a child, I loved the rain.
When I was little I loved the rain.
When I was little, I loved the rain.
sentences.hint: past simple — when, child, love, rain

sentences.it: Prima siamo andati in California, poi siamo andati in macchina a Los Angeles.
sentences.en: First we went to California, then we drove to Los Angeles.
alternatives: First, we went to California, then we drove to Los Angeles.
First we went to California and then we drove to Los Angeles.
sentences.hint: past simple + first, then — go, California, drive, Los Angeles

sentences.it: Dopo di che, abbiamo visitato una foresta enorme.
sentences.en: After that, we visited a huge forest.
alternatives: After that we visited a huge forest.
After that, we visited an enormous forest.
sentences.hint: past simple — after that, visit, huge, forest

sentences.it: Successivamente ho fatto una passeggiata fuori.
sentences.en: Next, I took a walk outside.
alternatives: Next I took a walk outside.
Next, I went for a walk outside.
Next I went for a walk outside.
sentences.hint: past simple — next, take a walk, outside

alternatives: Finally we went back home.
Finally, we came back home.
Finally, we returned home.
sentences.hint: past simple — finally, go back home

vocabulary.example: I was cooking while my sister was reading.
We both started talking at the same time.
I saw Marco at the station yesterday.
Last night I was watching TV when the phone rang.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Non è "ieri notte" parola per parola: "last" vuol dire "ultima", quindi è l'ultima notte passata.

vocabulary.example: Last weekend we went to the seaside.
We were watching a film when the lights went out.
I met my neighbour at the supermarket.
My dad reads the newspaper every morning.
I was taking a shower when you called.
vocabulary.mnemonic: In inglese la doccia si "prende" (take) o si "ha" (have), non si "fa": niente "make a shower".

vocabulary.example: The computer turned off in the middle of my work.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Pensa all'interruttore: "off" è la posizione spenta, "on" quella accesa.

vocabulary.example: After the storm we saw a beautiful rainbow.
vocabulary.mnemonic: È un "arco" (bow) fatto di "pioggia" (rain): rain + bow.

vocabulary.example: It was raining when we left the house.
The president was giving a speech on TV.
She is very observant and notices every detail.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Viene da "observe", osservare: chi è observant osserva tutto con attenzione.

vocabulary.example: We took a walk in the park after lunch.
The children were playing outside.
Sorry to interrupt, but dinner is ready.
I was driving to work when it started to snow.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Pensa al "driver", l'autista: è quello che guida.

vocabulary.example: We got a flat tire on the way to the airport.
vocabulary.mnemonic: "Flat" vuol dire piatto: la gomma bucata si sgonfia e diventa piatta.

vocabulary.example: They were walking through the forest when they heard a noise.
Can you set the table while I finish cooking?
vocabulary.mnemonic: Il verbo è "set", sistemare: la tavola si sistema, non si "prepara".

vocabulary.example: Someone knocked on the door while we were having dinner.
vocabulary.mnemonic: La "k" iniziale non si pronuncia: si dice "nock", come il rumore del colpo sulla porta.

vocabulary.example: My grandmother told us a funny story.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Falso amico: "story" è un racconto, la storia come materia è "history".

vocabulary.example: "Then" is an adverb of sequencing.
First of all, I switched on the oven.
I had breakfast and then I went to school.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Non confonderlo con "than" (di, nei paragoni): "then" con la e indica il tempo.

vocabulary.example: We visited the museum. After that, we had lunch.
Next, add the eggs and mix well.
Finally, we arrived at the hotel.
vocabulary.mnemonic: Falso amico: "finally" vuol dire "finalmente, alla fine", non "finale".

grammar.title: Past simple e past continuous con while
grammar.body:
## Past simple

Racconta un'azione **conclusa** nel passato.

- verbi **regolari**: si aggiunge **-ed** (*watch* → *watched*);
- verbi **irregolari**: hanno una forma propria (*go* → *went*, *see* → *saw*).

- *Last weekend, I watched a film.* — Il fine settimana scorso ho guardato un film.
- *Yesterday I went to the supermarket.* — Ieri sono andato al supermercato.

## Past continuous

**was / were + verbo in -ing.** Descrive un'azione **più lunga, in corso**, spesso come sfondo, come l'imperfetto italiano o "stavo facendo".

- *I was reading the newspaper.* — Stavo leggendo il giornale.

## Insieme, con while

Il past simple indica l'azione **più breve** che **interrompe** quella più lunga al past continuous. *While* (mentre) introduce l'azione che succede **nello stesso momento**, di solito al past continuous.

- *While I **was taking** a shower, the water **turned off**.* — Mentre facevo la doccia, è andata via l'acqua.
- *While I **was walking** home, I **saw** a rainbow.* — Mentre tornavo a casa, ho visto un arcobaleno.
- *It **rained** while the president **was speaking**.* — Ha piovuto mentre il presidente parlava.

Se le due azioni lunghe si svolgono insieme, tutte e due vanno al past continuous: *While I was cooking, he was setting the table.*

## Attenzione

Alcuni verbi non si usano nella forma in *-ing*: *be*, *love*, *hate*, *need*, *believe*… Si dice *When I was a child I **loved** the rain*, non *I was loving*.

grammar.title: Gli avverbi di sequenza nei racconti
grammar.body:
Danno l'ordine delle azioni in un racconto al passato:

1. *First* — Prima (di tutto)
2. *Then* — Poi
3. *After that* — Dopo di che
4. *Next* — Successivamente
5. *Finally* — Infine

*First, we went to California and saw the Redwood Forest. Then we drove to Los Angeles. While we were driving we got a flat tire.*

*Finally* chiude il racconto: è l'ultima azione.
